name: TrackMate (track XML)
note: TrackMate's 'Export tracks to XML': <Tracks><particle><detection t x y z/>. There are no columns to map — each <particle> IS a track, its id is its position in the file, t is the frame, and coordinates are in the file's spaceUnits (micron in every export seen). Detected from the .xml extension, so the mapping fields below are ignored.
